component.name: Mule central pressure hull
component.scale_note: The existing 50 m perspective concept is interpreted within existing catalog ship dimensions. 26 x 9.6 x 7.1 m is a new component envelope, not an existing measured mesh. It leaves lateral space for six external pods/trusses and fore/aft space for thrusters. Full assembly fit must be verified before replacing runtime geometry.

reference.interpretation: A source-faithful design study for the central cab/pressure tunnel, excluding the six freight pods and outer systems visible on the original board. Generated views are not guaranteed to be projections of one manifold 3D object.

registration.blender_export_note: Do not infer the orientation of a raw Tripo mesh. Fit its nose/up/right landmarks explicitly, preserve a transform record, and verify final Unity +Z nose/+Y up before export. No raw mesh transform exists yet.
limitations: Bounds normalization rescales each view independently. It corrects metric extents but does not prove agreement of individual panels, windows or surface normals.
Original generated end elevations use a different px/m scale from side/top views. Retain source and report; do not use the raw sheet directly as a six-view bake atlas.
Do not project background pixels into the hull. Registration outputs contain a foreground alpha mask.
Some tiny dark exposed service features fall outside the main pressure shell; ensure their mesh representation before baking their texture into a flat shell.

interior_contract.layout_coordinates: Layout local +Z runs aft, Y is standing eye height; this is not the exterior runtime +Z forward contract. Preserve the existing cabin adapter until measured.

missing_component_references.source_detail: Corrugated sealed rectangular cassette with reinforced ochre corners; three each side
Exposed longitudinal freight cradle; distinct pod attachment joints and clear gaps
Four rear-facing heavy thrusters specified by source concept prompt; confirm against actual runtime engine mounts
Rounded under-cab / spine utility tanks with routed conduits

missing_component_references.status: missing orthographic reference and hinge/attachment contract
missing independent moving-part reference; current art doors are closed
missing Mule-specific two-deck concept, modular room mesh and runtime interaction fit

pipeline.next_step: Use one isolated central-hull view as the initial local image-to-mesh experiment, then fit against all six registered views and existing two-deck envelope before texture projection. Do not feed the entire six-object sheet to single-image Tripo. Pause GPU inference until parent finishes concurrent Unity world tests.
bake_rules: Use a fresh non-overlapping UV layout after mesh fitting.
Bake top, bottom, port, starboard, nose, aft sequentially.
A later view must not recolor pixels owned by an earlier view.
Reopen saved blend after each bake and verify packed/external texture consistency.
Require matched-view silhouette/detail overlay and complete assembly/LOD review before runtime replacement.
